resolution: Closed as a completed diagnostic whose candidate was decided downstream (close-superseded). followup-10 separated, by intervention, two independent defects in the TAA resolve on the Sponza pose-W window (ledger H-04b, H-11..H-14). The first is an energy bias from the HDR weighting inside the reconstruction: the whole ROI holds 0.919 of the resampled input, and a 1.5-px bright bar loses 48.4 %. The second is a jitter-driven residual that the reconstruction creates on pixels whose own sample never changes. The clamp's share depends on the mask: about 35 % on the boundary pixels, where the variance box carries it, and 48.5 % over the whole window, where either box alone keeps most of it (H-04c). Removing the clamp was rejected (H-13). The candidate the task handed on, r.TAA.ReconstructionMode=1, was decided in followup-14 as r.TAA.ReconstructionHdrWeightExponent=0: it fails gates G1, G2, G6 and G7 and stays opt-in at 1.0 (H-21..H-23). The AABB-only clamp is rejected on G1 (-9.5 %); its G6 figure rests on single runs (H-23b). followup-14's reopening on 2026-09-16 for its own harness touches neither verdict. The diagnostic CVars r.TAA.JitterScale, ReconstructionMode, ClampMode and BlendMode, the taa+extra region records, scripts/flicker/taa_model.py, validate_taa_model.py, test_taa_modes.py, the run_taa_*.py harnesses and the W motion sequence landed in 7eea6b95, together with the fix of the dead r.TAA.CurrentFrameWeight (H-39). On 2026-10-08 three weak checks in test_taa_modes.py were fixed: a jitter control ending in `or True`, a BlendMode check that never set the weight, and a clip-box check that compared RGB with the lower corner only and never with taa_clip_max. The fixed script passed 12/12 on the GPU on 2026-10-09 (Debug build of 2cc2e85c; recorded in notes.md). The same review corrected tasks.md, notes.md and design.md with dated notes. The length-1 offset is (0, -0.167) px. 35 % is a boundary-mask figure. Two promising variants never ran the motion sequence. The strafe exercised disocclusion, but no metric isolated it. The git-ignored evidence package holds only summaries and manifests of single runs (24 frames per still-camera variant, one motion pass per motion variant). The two stale gtests reported in item 2.3 were fixed outside this task in 8246ab5c. Still open elsewhere: the window's static residual and energy bias (known-issues 'Static TAA residual' and 'TAA reconstruction HDR weighting'; ledger H-25b, H-26, H-01b's period and H-23b's motion repeats), owned by the proposed phase0_sponza-followup-15-taa-window-residual; motion and the GDF are in followup-13.
